title: Countdown
statement: Implement `solve(n)`. Return a list of the integers a countdown generator would yield: `n, n-1, ..., 1`. If `n` is less than 1, return an empty list. Do not include 0.
hints: Return a list so the judge can see the yields.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A generator yields one integer at a time and stops before 0.

editorial: A generator yields one integer at a time and stops before 0. Materializing it with list() is the caller's choice. The producer itself should not prebuild the list if you write it as a generator. The values are the same either way.
